data.name: Lucais
data.gender_notes: Lucais is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lukos', meaning 'light'. In Christian tradition, Lucais is a name given to those who bring light and enlightenment to others. This name is often associated with Saint Lucian, a 3rd-century martyr and bishop. The name Lucais carries the meaning “Light-giving” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lucais usually hope their child will grow to embody light-giving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing light and understanding to others.
data.etymology: Lucais belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light-giving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lucais total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: לוקאיס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לוקאיס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'נושא אור' או 'מביא בשורות טובות'. השם לוקאיס הוא צורה עברית של השם היווני 'Λουκάς' (לוקאס), שפירושו 'אדם שמביא אור'. השם לוקאיס מופיע בברית החדשה וקשור לאחד מהבשורה, לוקאס, שהיה תלמידו של פאולוס ושימש כרופא וכבישור.

in_greek.name: Λουκάς
in_greek.meaning: Λουκάς, ο εκφέρων φως ή αγγελιαφόρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Λουκάς είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'εκφέρων φως' ή 'αγγελιαφόρος'. Το όνομα Λουκάς συνδέεται με τον Ευαγγελιστή Λουκά, έναν από τους τέσσερις Ευαγγελιστές της Καινής Διαθήκης, που ήταν μαθητής του Παύλου και υπηρέτησε ως ιατρός και Ευαγγελιστής.

in_latin.name: Lucas
in_latin.meaning: Lucas, qui fert lucem aut nuntius
in_latin.long_meaning: Lucas est nomen Latinum quod significat 'qui fert lucem' aut 'nuntius'. Nomen Lucas derivatur ex Graeco 'Λουκάς' (Lucas), quod interpretatur 'homo qui lucem affert'. Lucas in Ecclesia primitiva Christiana fuit discipulus Pauli et Evangelista, qui scripsit Evangelium secundum Lucam.

in_english.name: Lucais
in_english.meaning: Bringer of light or good news
in_english.long_meaning: Lucais is a Christian name derived from the Greek 'Λουκάς' (Lucas), meaning 'bringer of light' or 'good news'. The name Lucais is associated with Saint Luke, one of the four Evangelists in the New Testament, who was a companion of Saint Paul and a physician. Lucais symbolizes illumination, hope, and the spreading of the Gospel message. The name Lucais has been used across various Christian cultures and is often chosen for its spiritual significance and historical importance.
